_meta.note: Verified values come from Farm RPG/Buddy pages. Amber estimates remain editable in Setup.
_meta.marketUnits: Price Check values ending in /k are per 1,000 items.

crop_qf_is_reduction.why: Quicker Farming I-IV plus Irrigation I-II: 80% reduction

crop_dod_base_cut.why: Diary of O'Dynn cuts 10% of base growth time

craft_cost_cap.why: Safety cap until the complete stacking rule is verified

net_fn_base_catch.why: Items per Fishing Net before Reinforced Netting

net_ln_base_catch.why: Items per Large Net before Reinforced Netting and Trigon Knot

cider_base_rolls.why: Stamina spent by one Apple Cider before Cinnamon Sticks. The game says: 1000+ Stamina Use | Does not give Stamina | Need at least 1000 Stamina to use. The key is named cider_base_rolls for history; it is stamina, not rolls.

lemonade_base_items.why: Items per Lemonade before Lemon Squeezer

ap_base_items.why: Items per Arnold Palmer before Lemon Squeezer

oj_stamina.why: Stamina restored by one Orange Juice

quandary_bonus.why: Quandary Chowder gives 10% more Lemonade/AP output

neigh_stamina_save.why: Neigh makes Cider use 20% less stamina

hickory_tick_bonus.why: Hickory Omelette adds 20% Sawmill production every 10 minutes for one hour

acorn_pie_actions.why: Acorn Pie adds Hide outside Forest for 150 actions; rate varies by location and method

explore_base_stamina.why: Base stamina opportunity per logged item roll

explore_stamina_measured.why: Your own measured stamina per explore, as a fraction of normal. 0 means fall back to the perk estimate. The perk list here is not a complete model of every stamina reduction in the game, so a measured value wins.

plot_yield_default.why: Crops harvested per planted seed before account-specific bonuses

rate_adjust_global.why: Multiplier for the archived community drop denominators

cooking_tools_not_consumed.why: Reusable tools excluded from cooking ingredient totals
